info.title: WorkNest API
info.description: Same-origin session API. Unknown JSON fields are rejected. Hidden resources return 404; disallowed visible actions return 403. Task/comment edits require version. See API.md for response details.

parameters.name: X-CSRFToken
parameters.description: Session CSRF token; send with its cookie.

2XX.description: Successful JSON response, binary download or empty 204 response.

default.description: Validation, access, conflict, throttle or dependency error.
